{
  "candidate_rtl": "`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

// Parallel priority selection.  The next round-robin mask is computed
// directly from request prefixes/suffixes, not from an encoded index.
module arbiter_select #(
    parameter PORTS = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0,
    parameter EW = $clog2(PORTS) > 0 ? $clog2(PORTS) : 2
)(
    input wire [PORTS-1:0] req,
    output wire valid,
    output wire [PORTS-1:0] winner,
    output wire [EW-1:0] index,
    output wire [PORTS-1:0] following_mask
);
    assign valid = |req;
    genvar i, b;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < PORTS; i = i+1) begin : select_bit
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : low_first
                if (i == 0) begin : edge_bit
                    assign winner[i] = req[i];
                    assign following_mask[i] = 1'b0;
                end else begin : inner_bit
                    assign winner[i] = req[i] & ~(|req[i-1:0]);
                    assign following_mask[i] = |req[i-1:0];
                end
            end else begin : high_first
                if (i == PORTS-1) begin : edge_bit
                    assign winner[i] = req[i];
                    assign following_mask[i] = 1'b0;
                end else begin : inner_bit
                    assign winner[i] = req[i] & ~(|req[PORTS-1:i+1]);
                    assign following_mask[i] = |req[PORTS-1:i+1];
                end
            end
        end
        for (b = 0; b < EW; b = b+1) begin : encode_bit
            wire [PORTS-1:0] terms;
            for (i = 0; i < PORTS; i = i+1) begin : encode_term
                if ((i >> b) & 1) begin : included
                    assign terms[i] = winner[i];
                end else begin : excluded
                    assign terms[i] = 1'b0;
                end
            end
            assign index[b] = |terms;
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule

module arbiter #(
    parameter PORTS = 4,
    parameter ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN = 0,
    parameter ARB_BLOCK = 0,
    parameter ARB_BLOCK_ACK = 1,
    parameter ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input wire [PORTS-1:0] request,
    input wire [PORTS-1:0] acknowledge,
    output wire [PORTS-1:0] grant,
    output wire grant_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] grant_encoded
);
    reg [PORTS-1:0] grant_reg, grant_next;
    reg grant_valid_reg, grant_valid_next;
    reg [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] grant_encoded_reg, grant_encoded_next;
    reg [PORTS-1:0] mask_reg, mask_next;

    assign grant = grant_reg;
    assign grant_valid = grant_valid_reg;
    assign grant_encoded = grant_encoded_reg;

    wire raw_valid, eligible_valid;
    wire [PORTS-1:0] raw_winner, eligible_winner;
    wire [PORTS-1:0] raw_following, eligible_following;
    wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] raw_index, eligible_index;

    arbiter_select #(
        .PORTS(PORTS),
        .LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY(ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY)
    ) select_raw (
        .req(request),
        .valid(raw_valid),
        .winner(raw_winner),
        .index(raw_index),
        .following_mask(raw_following)
    );

    arbiter_select #(
        .PORTS(PORTS),
        .LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY(ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY)
    ) select_eligible (
        .req(request & mask_reg),
        .valid(eligible_valid),
        .winner(eligible_winner),
        .index(eligible_index),
        .following_mask(eligible_following)
    );

    always @* begin
        grant_next = 0;
        grant_valid_next = 0;
        grant_encoded_next = 0;
        mask_next = mask_reg;

        if (ARB_BLOCK && !ARB_BLOCK_ACK && (grant_reg & request)) begin
            grant_next = grant_reg;
            grant_valid_next = grant_valid_reg;
            grant_encoded_next = grant_encoded_reg;
        end else if (ARB_BLOCK && ARB_BLOCK_ACK && grant_valid && !(grant_reg & acknowledge)) begin
            grant_next = grant_reg;
            grant_valid_next = grant_valid_reg;
            grant_encoded_next = grant_encoded_reg;
        end else if (raw_valid) begin
            grant_valid_next = 1'b1;
            if (ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN) begin
                if (eligible_valid) begin
                    grant_next = eligible_winner;
                    grant_encoded_next = eligible_index;
                    mask_next = eligible_following;
                end else begin
                    grant_next = raw_winner;
                    grant_encoded_next = raw_index;
                    mask_next = raw_following;
                end
            end else begin
                grant_next = raw_winner;
                grant_encoded_next = raw_index;
            end
        end
    end

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        grant_reg <= grant_next;
        grant_valid_reg <= grant_valid_next;
        grant_encoded_reg <= grant_encoded_next;
        mask_reg <= mask_next;
        if (rst) begin
            grant_reg <= 0;
            grant_valid_reg <= 0;
            grant_encoded_reg <= 0;
            mask_reg <= 0;
        end
    end
endmodule

// Original general-purpose priority encoder interface and invalid-input
// behavior retained, including its overridable LEVELS and W parameters.
module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);
    parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
    parameter W = 2**LEVELS;
    wire [W-1:0] input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid[LEVELS-1:0];
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc[LEVELS-1:0];
    genvar l, n;
    generate
        for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n+1) begin : loop_in
            assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
            end else begin
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
            end
        end
        for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l+1) begin : loop_levels
            for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n+1) begin : loop_compress
                assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
                if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] = stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ? {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} : {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
                end else begin
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] = stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ? {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} : {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
                end
            end
        end
    endgenerate
    assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The original round-robin feedback path passes through masked priority encoding, index selection, arithmetic and a variable shift to rebuild mask_reg. Grant generation also decodes the encoded winner back into a one-hot vector.",
  "rewrite": "Compute the two priority winners directly with parallel prefix/suffix reductions. Encode each one-hot winner using OR reductions. Independently compute each candidate round-robin mask directly from request prefixes or suffixes, eliminating index arithmetic and variable shifts from the mask feedback path. Retain the original named state registers, synchronous reset, hold conditions and output registers.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected improvement is primarily on mask_reg feedback and one-hot grant generation: the encode/arithmetic/barrel-shift cascade is replaced by reduction logic and selection. No numerical WNS gain is claimed because synthesis, placement and STA have not been run.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Uses two parallel winner networks and reduction-based encoders, trading some reduction fanout for removal of decoding and variable-shift logic. Register count is unchanged. Compliance with the 4855.656960 um2 area cap and electrical limits requires mapped evaluation; it is not measured here.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves arbitration priority, blocking-on-acknowledge behavior, request-based blocking for other parameter settings, wraparound, idle outputs, mask retention, registered latency and repeated synchronous reset. Existing state encodings and names are retained without initialization attributes. No initial-state or input assumptions are introduced. Invalid internal selection results are never committed. The standalone priority_encoder retains its original invalid-input behavior and parameter interface."
}
